principle: Every outbound channel starts from evidence, not a static topic calendar, and writes outcome learning back to the exact source lineage.

linkedin_personal.selection: Preserve authentic personal life, observation and verified builder modes. For verified first-person builder posts: link one factual Arthur engineering choice to ONE relevant independently sourced human/entrepreneur friction and one unified software-AI-BI-data system; do not invent clients, outcomes or force external signal into Arthur's experience.

personal_builder_context_intake.source_priority: author_verified_build_event_first; external problem radar and VOC are optional editorial context only
personal_builder_context_intake.source_event_truth: public signals never verify a personal Arthur experience
personal_builder_context_intake.cross_channel_copy: same underlying issue may inform distinct voices but never reuse Mira fictional scene or corporate copy

conversation_quality_20261120.objective: Genuine substantive discussion from evidence-grounded personal storytelling; comments are earned, never compelled.

measurement.source: independently authorized original personal LinkedIn provider metrics only
measurement.primary: meaningful on-topic comments and real discussion quality

trusted_advisor_approach.role: Independent advisor who diagnoses, implements, makes reliable, transfers and trains; explain relevant AI/data/BI/software/agentic trade-off in own verified human story when relevant.
avoid: claims that every product module is already live
trusted_advisor_approach.original_approval: preserve source-backed personal source/review hash and provider auth

linkedin_company.selection: rank concrete CEO/MT problems by freshness, evidence, business impact, recurrence and Powerhouse fit

blog.selection: prefer evidence-backed problem plus search/commercial intent; improve an owned page before creating cannibalizing content

email.selection: only contact when the evidence is relevant to the recipient/company and suppression/consent/quality gates pass

linkedin_dm.selection: same account-level evidence discipline as email; use a human-relevant micro-CTA and preserve provider/auth boundaries

instagram_company.selection: fresh public human-problem evidence outranks static seeds

fallback_rule: Static calendars are fallback only when no fresh eligible source-backed candidate exists.
cross_channel_rule: One source can create channel-specific candidates, but copy and CTA must be native to each channel; never copy-paste the same post across channels.
learning_rule: Outcome learning updates source quality, problem priority, message angle, CTA, channel fit and next-best action.

trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.channels: One position, appropriate evidence-driven voice per channel: personal story != company website != client portal != training offer
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.person_training_rule: Only describe actually given workshops and coaching when the individual event is verifiable; proposed new curricula are planned offers, not proven completed training.
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.personal_creative_rule: One authentic lived problem, choice or tradeoff per post. Independent trusted advisor demonstrated through judgement and responsibility, not title or a list of AI tools. No forced commercial CTA or product stack inventory.
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.business_promise_rule: Do not claim robust autonomous agentic implementation, customer impact or full portal module availability until exact destination security, deployment and provider readback and measured outcomes are established.
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.portal_rule: User-language: what plays, what matters, what happens next; preserve existing Portal V2 and existing ONE BRAIN->Powerhouse->Heartbeat original path.
trusted_advisor_positioning_20261120.learning: Use personal meaningful comments only if independently observed, CRM/portal sales only if real; no ROI guesses or fake training enrollments.
